description_en: Market state is NOT risk-off at window open
description_zh: 窗口开启时市场状态非避险
notes: Reads data/market_state/latest.json .verdict (string). PIT by construction: the nightly that runs after market close commits the file before the turn desk step. Filter true when verdict != RISK_OFF. Source artifact chosen over data/neuralweb/world_state.json for simplicity: market_state verdict is a flat string; world_state verdict is nested .verdict.verdict. Both are nightly-committed and PIT-valid.

description_en: VIX percentile >= 0.6 at window open (elevated-vol regime)
description_zh: 窗口开启时VIX百分位>=0.6（高波动率状态）
notes: Reads panel_s.parquet column vix_pctile for the armed node at the window-open date. Node-level read — takes the value for the armed ETF node at the fire date row. Null when the column is missing or the row is absent (null-honest law). The 0.6 threshold is frozen at registration; re-registration required to change it.

description_en: Operator tape touch on armed node within +/-3 sessions of window open
description_zh: 窗口开启前后3个交易日内运营商标注了该板块
notes: Tape-touch predicate: finds any operator_tape row (excluding schema_note header) where the armed ETF node appears in the row's nodes[] list, pit_stamp is within +/-3 trading sessions of the window_open fire_date, and direction matches the armed context (in, not out). schema_note rows are skipped. PIT by construction: pit_stamp on each tape row is the operator-authored timestamp.
